invariants.rationale: Since 'data' is iterated in the implementation, it is likely to be non-null.
The method applies reduceFunc to values; it must be non-null to avoid NullPointerExceptions.
Parallelism indicates the level of concurrency; non-positive parallelism likely makes no sense in context.
When data is not empty, parallelism should likely not exceed data.size(), as that would result in under-utilization.
The method processes each Pair in data, so null elements could cause exceptions.
